entities.name: The Renaissance Period
entities.label: Timeframe
entities.summary: The cultural and intellectual "rebirth" (c. 1350-1600) originating in Italian city-states, characterized by renewed interest in classical antiquity, humanist philosophy, artistic innovation, and scientific inquiry. The Renaissance produced Leonardo, Michelangelo, Machiavelli, and Copernicus, transforming European art, science, politics, and self-understanding.
